notes: Watchdog policy (FM-010). Silence thresholds are declared per sensor rather than derived from update rate, because update rate is how often an adapter polls and has almost nothing to do with how often a target is in its coverage. Measured across all nine scenarios with no fault present, the narrow-field EO/IR sensor's longest legitimate quiet spell was 81 s against the wide radars' 10.5 s — so one number cannot serve both, and a number derived from poll rate flagged the healthiest sensor on the site continuously. Resolution is most-specific-first: sensor id, then sensor type, then the default.
